name: 4p0q7c-tracker-launch-context
goal: A fresh tracker session loads bounded item history: tracker show and the launch brief stay small while every note stays readable in pages

evidence: Sonnet launches reach 150k in 3-13 min (6kmyg7, gqrac3 transcripts): start about 46k, about 105k growth. tracker show 6kmyg7 prints 102,765 chars (212 notes); one run read about 80k chars of dumped notes. The brief and done-proof rule send sessions to show --json. Expected: bounded show and brief, every note readable in pages.

tracker-cli-compat.test.ts exercised show only on an item with no history and tracker-host-brief.test.ts used notes_log: [], so no fixture or assertion bounded output size. Both suites gain long-history fixtures with size budgets and completeness assertions.
